record_audits.database_measure: Sequence analysis: APD analysis reveals that this sequence is similar (37.14%) to Arenicin-3 analog N3. V: 14%; C=K=R: 11%. Activity: killed K. pneumoniae (60% at 3.125 uM; 100% at 25 uM) but not S-aureus MRSA at 25 uM. Warning: Nonstandard assays, killing in PBS for 18 h followed by plating and overnight growth on MHB plate. Warning: other bacteria not tested. Inhibited biofilm formation 30% at 5 uM (48 h). In vitro toxicity: human RBC: <20% hemolysis at 100 uM after 16 h incubation (less hemo.lytic).
record_audits.conflict_context: APD6 row is an entry-level commentary with rounded/threshold activity language and no sequence field in the packet snapshot; primary Table 1 identity and source activity prose were checked, but exact APD row normalization remains preserved as source_conflict.
record_audits.review_notes: APD6 record is preserved as source_conflict because it is not a row-level primary-source assay record, although its broad claims are source-plausible.
